sources.title: Particle Data Group 2025 Review of Particle Physics / Particle Properties
sources.scope_used: established quark, lepton, neutrino, gauge-boson and Higgs particle taxonomy; hypothetical-particle searches kept separate

sources.title: Simulating two-dimensional lattice gauge theories on a qudit quantum computer
sources.scope_used: trapped-ion qudit hardware can encode gauge fields/matter and experimentally study lattice-gauge dynamics; this is simulator evidence, not a direct quark/gluon device

sources.title: Digital Quantum Simulation of a (1+1)D SU(2) Lattice Gauge Theory with Ion Qudits
sources.scope_used: qudit encoding and experimentally motivated gate construction for non-Abelian SU(2) dynamics; not direct color-charge hardware

sources.title: Observation of string breaking on a (2+1)D Rydberg quantum simulator
sources.scope_used: experimental simulator analogue of confinement/string breaking; not manipulation of isolated QCD quarks

sources.title: Qutrit and qubit circuits for three-flavor collective neutrino oscillations
sources.scope_used: three-flavor neutrino dynamics mapped to qubit/qutrit circuits with small-system demonstrations on IBM and Quantinuum hardware; simulator evidence, not direct neutrino-device control

sources.title: Collective neutrino oscillations in three flavors on qubit and qutrit processors
sources.scope_used: two-neutrino hardware experiment on superconducting qubit/qutrit platforms and resource-mapping evidence

sources.title: Constraints on axion dark matter by distributed intercity quantum sensors
sources.scope_used: real distributed nuclear-spin sensor network constrains axion scenarios; technology evidence for the sensor, not axion discovery

string_theory_scope.rule: string/M-theory/holography may motivate candidate particles or information structures, but are not elementary-particle device evidence unless tied to a concrete observable and experimentally controllable bridge

research_attribution.ai_assisted_contribution: current public-literature triage and evidence-boundary mapping for elementary-particle technology bridges
